title: Matched D13 lower-boundary representation discriminator
scientific_question: On the immutable F-ROMV2-D13 fixed-water-table capillary-relaxation workload, how does the full frozen LARE resolution ladder compare with R2 coarse Richards and FMC/SMVE on balance, profile and lower-boundary flux fidelity?

workload.initial_profile: Exact finite-water-content D13 physical profile: theta(y)=theta_i+dtheta*sum_j I(H_j>=y), H_j=lambda*|psi(theta_j)|.
workload.bottom_boundary: zero pressure head at fixed 160-cm lower boundary

lare_route.interface_flux: published adjacent-layer first-order Taylor LARE closure
lare_route.initial_projection: Integrate the exact D13 physical theta profile over each frozen LARE layer; use exact layer water depth as initial state.

balance: pooled total-storage RMSE vs D13 R16
pooled cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE vs D13 R16
lower_boundary: pooled terminal-bottom-flux RMSE vs D13 R16
profile: mapped R16 10-cm cell-theta RMSE from piecewise-constant LARE layer means

comparator_reconstruction.R2: Recompute all C4Q metrics directly from immutable D13 R2_o0.txt and R16_o0.txt, including mapped 10-cm theta and upper/lower storage.
comparator_reconstruction.FMC: Use immutable D13 raw result for balance, terminal flux, sign and mapped-theta metrics. Do not rerun, refit or reinterpret FMC.
comparator_reconstruction.R16: Immutable D13 R16_o0.txt is scientific reference behavior, not mathematical truth.

frontier_rules.member_crosses_R2: Any QUALIFIED reduced LARE member (dimension < 16) has no worse total-storage RMSE, cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE, terminal-bottom-flux RMSE, mapped-theta RMSE or sign-error count than reconstructed D13 R2.
frontier_rules.member_crosses_FMC: Any QUALIFIED reduced LARE member (dimension < 16) has no worse the same five metrics than immutable D13 FMC.
frontier_rules.selection: Report every attempted member and its domain status. Among QUALIFIED reduced members, report the lowest frozen dimension, if any, satisfying each frontier rule. R16 is reported only as an operator control and cannot establish reduced-model frontier crossing.

decisions.LARE_REDUCED_FRONTIER_CROSSES_FMC: Hard gates pass and at least one QUALIFIED reduced LARE member crosses FMC on all five frontier views.
decisions.LARE_REDUCED_FRONTIER_CROSSES_R2_NOT_FMC: Hard gates pass, no reduced member crosses FMC, and at least one QUALIFIED reduced member crosses R2 on all five views.
decisions.LARE_REDUCED_FRONTIER_DOES_NOT_CROSS_R2: Hard gates pass, at least one reduced member is QUALIFIED, and no QUALIFIED reduced member crosses R2 on all five views.
decisions.LARE_REDUCED_DOMAIN_NO_GO: Hard gates pass but no reduced member is QUALIFIED.
decisions.C4Q_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED: D13 provenance, fail-closed semantics, or R16 operator-control execution fails.

interpretation_boundaries: C4Q is exposed matched-workload development evidence, not blind confirmation.
No single scalar score or overall model ranking is allowed.
A frontier crossing is bounded to the D13 fixed-water-table capillary-relaxation workload.
R2 remains a comparator, not ground truth.
FMC remains a distinct physical-reduction family and its D13 result is not generalized beyond its envelope.
No application acceptance, speed claim or production ROM is authorized.

pre_execution_domain_policy.rationale: Existing BC1 authority already demonstrates that aggressive low-dimensional LARE members can legitimately leave the strict theta/near-saturation qualified domain under wet head-driven states. C4Q therefore treats per-member fail-closed domain loss as representation evidence rather than invalidating the whole ladder.
pre_execution_domain_policy.scientific_effect: Preserves fail-closed domain coverage as an explicit comparator dimension; does not alter formulas, metrics or frontier inequalities.
